newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil quiet, barges static, holidays hit Mediterranean.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil quiet, barges static, holidays hit Mediterranean.

text.p: NWE fuel oil markets were quiet on Friday with barge prices static in thin trade.
Dealers said $82 fob ARA was offered with buying interest at $81 and $81.50 for prompt. Heading into May buying interest was at $82.50 and $83.
But by late morning no deals were seen done, confirming the week's lacklustre trend. Traders anticipated something selling later at around the $82 mark.
"It's unbelievably quiet, a really boring market," said one trader. "Prices are really stuck in a range and I hope they break out, up or down."
Cargoes were also quiet, with Italy's Liberation Day holiday slowing business in the Mediterranean.
